summary: 1935 Pittsburgh-Des Moines windmill-style tower in Kabetogama State Forest; the earlier 1924 tower was replaced in 1935 and re-erected at Elephant Lake in 1940.

facts.design: 81-foot Pittsburgh-Des Moines windmill-style tower with an octagonal cab

events.note: First steel ladder tower at the site, per the county list; not the extant tower
80-foot ladder tower; the Register mentions only this earlier tower
Current Pittsburgh-Des Moines tower, the third lookout at the site
The 1924 tower was removed (Register) or replaced (county list) in 1935
The 1924 tower was erected at the Elephant Lake site (county list)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register says the 1924 tower was removed in 1935; the county list says it was replaced that year and later erected at Elephant Lake in 1940. Both can be true: it left the site in 1935 and was re-erected elsewhere in 1940.

notes_for_editor: Height: the Register and county list say 81 ft (24.7 m, used here); the Forest Lookouts page says 80 ft. The record had 24.4 m (80 ft). The 1923 and 1924 towers come only from the county list; the Register mentions only the 1924 tower's anchors. No current access or staffing source was found, so the story does not say whether the public may climb. The Register's 2018 photo credit is not repeated. The Forest Lookouts page is a hobbyist site reproducing NGS data, cited only for the 1948 description and 80-foot figure. No photos added; the Commons category may hold Creative Commons images, not checked.
